legacy_cutover.rule: Only the exact 1628 frozen historical records at their original ID, later status, and updated_at may validate without retrospective scope assessments. Any edit or state transition invalidates this exception and requires a complete passes_both_gates assessment. No new record can enter the cutover registry.

borderline_human_review.only_when: A specific material Albuquerque connection and credible public-information value exist, but the usefulness/significance judgment is genuinely close.
never_use_for: privacy, provenance, version/finality, legal-status, source-recovery, or another non-scope human-review reason
borderline_human_review.advance_rule: No record with requires_human_scope_review may advance to an eligible publication state until a human disposition is durably applied to inventory and the relevant family decision artifact.

regression_enforcement: Test-MasterInventory.ps1 and Update-Candidate.ps1 require complete positive assessments in all eight progress statuses except for the immutable exact-record legacy cutover. Test-MissionScopeEligibility.ps1 exercises historical validation and new-record transitions. Test-MissionScopeAudit.py validates the 2026-09-22 correction and scope-gated ranking. Test-MissionScopeBorderlineQueue.py and Test-MissionScopeBorderlineDispositions.py validate the isolated queue, durable human history, and idempotent disposition application.
